parts.name: ToolbarRoot
parts.description: The toolbar: a `<div>` with the `toolbar` role. It is one Tab stop; the arrow keys along its orientation move between its items, and Tab comes back to the item focused last.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every item. Buttons and inputs stay focusable unless they set `focusableWhenDisabled={false}`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Whether the items run `horizontal`ly (ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between them) or `vertical`ly (ArrowUp and ArrowDown).

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the arrow keys wrap around at the ends.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toolbar is disabled.

parts.name: ToolbarButton
parts.description: A `<button>` that is an item of the toolbar.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled button does nothing when pressed, and its `onClick` isn't called. It is also disabled when its group or the toolbar is.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether the button stays focusable while disabled, so the arrow keys still reach it. It then gets `aria-disabled` instead of the `disabled` attribute.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the button is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focusable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the button stays focusable while disabled.

parts.name: ToolbarLink
parts.description: An `<a>` that is an item of the toolbar. A link can't be disabled.

parts.name: ToolbarInput
parts.description: An `<input>` that is an item of the toolbar. The arrow keys move its caret, and move to the next item only from the end of the text (or the previous one from its start); Home and End stay with the input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled input takes no typing. It is also disabled when its group or the toolbar is.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether the input stays focusable while disabled. It then gets `aria-disabled` instead of the `disabled` attribute.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focusable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input stays focusable while disabled.

parts.name: ToolbarGroup
parts.description: A `<div>` with the `group` role around related items. Name it with `aria-label`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every item in the group.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the group is disabled.

parts.name: ToolbarSeparator
parts.description: A `<div>` with the `separator` role that runs across the toolbar: vertical in a horizontal toolbar, horizontal in a vertical one.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The separator's own orientation, when it shouldn't run across the toolbar.
